reasons.plausibility: The approach of tailoring interphase boundary coherence to mitigate dislocation pile-ups is scientifically sound and aligns with known strengthening/ductilizing strategies, though details of maintaining strength could present minor issues.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis can be decisively tested by comparing mechanical properties and microstructural characterization (TEM, fractography) of treated versus untreated samples, a clear and standard approach in metallurgy.
reasons.usefulness: Precisely targeting boundary coherency is highly relevant to improving ductility while maintaining strength in lamellar eutectic HEAs, making this a valuable avenue for researchers investigating room-temperature brittleness.
